findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/session-ownership-and-write-leases.md has contradictory current-state wording: lines 5-14 and 16-40 say the owner/write-lease baseline is implemented and B-a781 is only a future migration target, while line 44 still says in present tense that Lattice does not yet mechanically own write coordination across sessions. This makes the touched doc internally inconsistent; rename that section as historical/original problem or update the sentence to describe the pre-B-c55d problem.
